## History

Commissioned by Louis XVI in 1785, Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse, embarked on a voyage of circumnavigation aboard the corvette Boussole. During his expedition, he visited Botany Bay, the Friendly Isles, [New Caledonia](../codex/places.md#new-caledonia), and Namouka before reaching the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro). After losing his vessels on the local reefs, he attempted to construct a smaller boat to continue his journey, only to be lost at sea.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P26](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P40](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046)_
